evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Directive issued by Quinton in the imperative-like declarative form 'from now on', drawing on his position to set a standing process; no hedge or consultation.

evidence.quote: is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Argues for the rehearsal requirement by definitional logic (an unrehearsed rollback is no rollback), a reasoning-from-premise move rather than a claim of rank.
